conclusion.actual_airtime_and_radio_joules: unavailable before P4B; all bytes and conditional coefficients retained
conclusion.capacity_bottleneck: not demonstrated; no serialization/MAC model exists in this gateway
conclusion.delay_and_expiry: injected delay/loss and finite admission handshake are measured separately from capacity contention
conclusion.negative_result: 通信不是瓶颈：当前 ideal 应用传输没有带宽排队证据；Wi-Fi 是否成为瓶颈尚未测量
conclusion.next_research_direction: keep the measured load; test communication savings and calibrate network before considering RL
